title: TinyMaix int8 fully-connected layer
summary: tml_fc from TinyMaix: 64 output channels x 512 int8 inputs, one tm_dot_prod per channel, integer requantization.
reference_note: TinyMaix ships a hand-written T-Head E907 version (src/arch_rv32p.h) built on the vendor instruction smaqa (4x int8 multiply-accumulate).
